mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals weakening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past two months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the past month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past two months signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining and Real GDP (GDPC1) is below its 12-month moving average, the combination signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is declining and GDPC1 is below its 12-month moving average.
